title: Marlowe Rewards Privileges in Price Protection — Bookings That Set the Protected Price (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
For Pre-Orders & Back-Orders price protection, the bookings that can set the protected price depend on the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership. Every booking considered is a booked order line on the customer's own Online Orders, dated on or after the reservation date. The most recent booking of the kind the membership allows gives the protected price.

| Marlowe Rewards membership | Bookings that set the protected price |
|---|---|
| Active Icon or Atelier, enrolled 36 months or more | The most recent booking of the reserved style in any colour or size, at regular or clearance price. When a regular-price and a clearance booking fall on the same day, the regular-price booking wins |
| Active Gold or Platinum, enrolled 24 months or more | The most recent regular-price booking of the reserved style in any colour or size |
| Every other customer | The most recent regular-price booking of the reserved SKU itself. Other colours and sizes of the style, and clearance bookings, do not set the price |

The months are counted from the enrolment date of the active membership to today. The style is the product reserved, across all its colours and sizes. The SKU is the exact style, colour and size reserved.

**Illustration.** A hypothetical reservation of one SKU, reserved 1 June. The customer's Online Orders show these bookings dated on or after 1 June:

- the reserved style in another colour, regular price, $180.00 on 10 June;
- the reserved style in another size, clearance price, $150.00 on 12 June;
- the reserved SKU itself, regular price, $190.00 on 5 June.

| Membership | Booking that sets the protected price | Protected price |
|---|---|---|
| Active Icon, enrolled 40 months | Clearance booking of 12 June | $150.00 |
| Active Gold, enrolled 30 months | Regular-price booking of 10 June | $180.00 |
| Active Icon, enrolled 20 months | The SKU's own regular-price booking of 5 June | $190.00 |
| Active Silver, any tenure | The SKU's own regular-price booking of 5 June | $190.00 |

**Same-day case.** Suppose a regular-price style booking at $175.00 had also been made on 12 June. For the active Icon member enrolled 40 months, the regular-price booking wins that day, and the protected price is $175.00.
